ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Show Control recognizes performer-owned cue phrases locally while voice control is explicitly armed.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Show Control uses Bluetooth only for performer-assigned show buttons such as Flic.
ios.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Show Control imports your audio into private on-device show storage.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Show Control connects to your paired computer to prepare music and save it on this device.
